verdicts.reason: A breaks the design: the logo is blown up into the largest element and competes with the headline, the coffee bag shrinks to a thumbnail in a narrow strip, the CTA becomes a tiny pill in the bottom right, and the body copy is squeezed into a ragged four-line column far from the headline. Reading order and grouping are lost. B keeps the original layout, hierarchy and brand almost exactly. Its only flaw is that the photo panel no longer bleeds, so it floats with uneven bands of dark background above and below it and leaves a thin strip on the right.
